user.title: JMA Nowcast Setup
user.description:
Set up Japan Meteorological Agency High-Resolution Precipitation Nowcast.
Drag the map marker to set the monitoring location and drag the circle edge to set the radius.
Defaults to your HA home location with a 1 km radius.

data_description.location: Use the map marker as the monitoring point and the circle radius as the area
data_description.forecast_minutes: Select one or more future time windows to check (up to 60 min ahead)
data_description.threshold_mm: Rainfall intensity at or above this value counts as rain. 1.0=light, 5.0=moderate
data_description.trigger_coverage: How much of the area inside the radius must exceed the threshold to trigger
data_description.no_rain_cooldown_min: If an alert fires but no actual rain is observed, return to ready after this many minutes (0 = legacy behavior)
data_description.post_rain_cooldown_min: Wait this many minutes after observed rain ends before the next alert is allowed (0 = legacy behavior)
data_description.scan_interval: JMA Nowcast updates every 5 minutes, so 5 min is recommended
data_description.show_grid: Overlays JMA data pixel boundaries (precipitation mesh) as thin gridlines. Only drawn at zoomed-in scales

init.title: JMA Nowcast Settings
init.description: Choose which configuration category to edit.

basic.title: Basic Settings
basic.description: Adjust monitoring location, radius, trigger conditions, and cooldowns. Enable "Reset to HA home" to discard the current map values and revert to HA home with a 1 km radius on save.

data_description.location: Use the map marker as the monitoring point and the circle radius as the area
data_description.reset_to_home: If enabled when saving, ignores the map and reverts to HA home with a 1 km radius
data_description.forecast_minutes: Select one or more future time windows to check (up to 60 min ahead)
data_description.threshold_mm: Rainfall intensity at or above this value counts as rain. 1.0=light, 5.0=moderate
data_description.trigger_coverage: How much of the area inside the radius must exceed the threshold to trigger
data_description.no_rain_cooldown_min: If an alert fires but no actual rain is observed, return to ready after this many minutes (0 = immediate)
data_description.post_rain_cooldown_min: Wait this many minutes after observed rain ends before the next alert is allowed (0 = immediate)
data_description.scan_interval: JMA Nowcast updates every 5 minutes, so 5 min is recommended
data_description.show_grid: Overlays JMA data pixel boundaries (precipitation mesh) as thin gridlines. Only drawn at zoomed-in scales

alert_audio.title: Alert Audio
alert_audio.description: Announce via TTS on READY→ALERTED. Bucket matching first_rain_in_minutes (10/20/30/60) is used. Templates support both Jinja2 ({{mm_10}}, {% if rain_60 %}...{% endif %}) and simple substitution ({mm}). Variables: mm/mm_10/mm_20/mm_30/mm_60=each bucket's forecast mm/h (range max), rain_10..rain_60=has rain per bucket (bool), first_min=first rain in minutes, observed_mm=current observed mm/h, stops_at=first bucket after first_min where rain stops (int|None), still_raining_60=still raining at 60 min (bool), test=whether this is a test playback. Use button.jma_nowcast_test_alert_XXmin to test.

data_description.alert_tts_entity: TTS entity to use (e.g. tts.google_translate_XX). If unset, no alert is played
data_description.alert_targets: Media players to broadcast on. Shared across all buckets
data_description.alert_10_message: e.g. Rain of {mm} mm/h expected in about 10 minutes
data_description.alert_20_message: e.g. Rain will intensify to {mm} mm/h in 20 minutes
data_description.alert_30_message: e.g. Rain of {mm} mm/h expected to continue at 30 minutes
data_description.alert_60_message: e.g. Rain should end within 60 minutes
